gloss: to snatch away; to seize; to wrest

definitions.gloss: to snatch away, to seize, to wrest, to grab forcefully
definitions.explanation: To take something from someone by force or aggressive action. Stronger than simply taking — implies overcoming resistance or competition.

examples.japanese: ボールを{奪|うば}い{取|と}った。
{泥棒|どろぼう}がバッグを{奪|うば}い{取|と}って{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: The thief snatched the bag and ran away.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}は{最後|さいご}の{瞬間|しゅんかん}に{勝利|しょうり}を{奪|うば}い{取|と}った。
examples.english: The player seized victory at the last moment.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb from {奪|うば}う (to rob, take) + {取|と}る (to take). The combination emphasizes the forceful, decisive nature of the action. Used both literally (physical snatching) and figuratively (seizing victory, power, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝利|しょうり}を{奪|うば}い{取|と}る: to seize victory
- {主導権|しゅどうけん}を{奪|うば}い{取|と}る: to wrest the initiative
- {力|ちから}ずくで{奪|うば}い{取|と}る: to take by force
